notes.title: So. 2026. 10 years, huh?
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/4cdf4cc9e1a147d4110ef4c3a1c70bed0f131919.png[/img]

Hot on the heels of saying that we're only working on one singular project next year..... well, we didn't lie. Exactly. We're not currently planning on working on a second project for 2026 as of now.

But.

Next year is our 10th year of not going out of business, and we would really love to do *something*. Some sort of 10th Anniversary Edition of some game - obviously, with new stuff. New story. New content. It's not our style just to do the same thing over again (*pushes the Black Goat of the Woods Editions under the rug*). 

Would people want to see an Army of Tentacles 10th Anniversary Edition or a Paper Shakespeare 10th Anniversary Edition?

notes.title: Steg Stuff, 8.15.2025
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/7a3d0cb9073d8dc91a63e62dcd22e93c3c85c831.png[/img]

Due to the rest of the year getting unbelievably, ungodly busy within the past two weeks, everything has been pushed back. [b]Hamlet[/b] and [b]Dino Shakes[/b] will still come out this year, but [b]Dino Shakes[/b] just is not able to launch next month anymore now that so much medical stuff is going on basically every other week back to back. 

"Teehee tehee, I'll just make three small hand drawn games to close out 2025".... yeah. LOL.

The [b]Scarecrows[/b] rewrite will come out in 2026. There will be no other projects besides this one for next year. We'll talk about that one..... probably next year. We know that 2026 is our 10 Year, but as of now, we don't really have anything set up for a 10 Year launch. 

There's just too much going on, fam.

notes.title: Scarecrows of Illyria Update, 7.30.2025
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/fe245532dd48bb8f48e51ef2d1553f0d7bacf31d.png[/img]

We're still working on the rewrite, but have come up with against a wall. For a variety of reasons, some of us would like a new game entirely, much like Joe Papp 2 is just the rewrite of Joe Papp 1, and some of us think the rewrite should still be a patch. 

We are currently debating what the best route is, both financially and creatively. 

We will keep you posted.

notes.title: TENTACLE PRAWN post-campaign DLC is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/045ed0bf134993f6280b9b3db8d9cc71c2eef65d.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245540/Tentacle_Prawn_Actually_A_Cthulhu_Dating_Sim_New_Game_Benefits_HD/?beta=0

The final DLC for Tentacle Prawn is out now, and for some reason, this post did not out last night! Never fear, for now it [i]has[/i].

Rewritten and recoded about three times, it now exists as sort of an Epilogue-Dev Diary hybrid. With choices! And characters that you might not have seen since Super Army of Tentacles 3 (but who have aged in real time because that's the kind of detail gamers notice, right?). 

What shall become of the Old Gods now that they have returned to the past to right the wrongs of.... the past? Will they be fated to return to the dating sim dimension once more? Will anyone kiss? Is kissing still a thing? These are important questions that need answers hammered out before the new world order becomes the new world order.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/0e3763cdc85e5b4bab78253b096d0e38a89aecab.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727790/Tentacle_Prawn_Actually_A_Cthulhu_Dating_Sim/?beta=0

Don't forget that the base game is currently discounted during the Steam Summer Sale of 2025!

notes.title: DINOSAUR SHAKESPEARE 3 announced!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/5e0a6c5533936126db4dfc2b046e655f6efe8a83.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3827390/Dinosaur_Shakespeare_3_They_Are_On_The_Moon_Now_And_It_Escalated_Quickly__Bloodcore_Edition/?beta=0
As we dive into the final two games of the year, it's time to talk about what the first of those will be. Starting with [b]Camp Apocalypse Blood[/b], we decided that we wanted to make a trilogy of ridiculously ridiculous "hand drawn" games, but that we also didn't want to do three "stick figure" games again. 

So now you have dinosaurs in outer space. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/482c3da99859bc1d38c9a6e1b8a4688cbc5618d4.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820980/Scarecrows_of_Illyria_Canon_Rewrite_Emotional_Spoons_Pack/?beta=0
We also wanted a visual indicator on our store page that the Scarecrows rewrite is still coming out, and so we came up with the idea to release a free stat upgrade DLC alongside it.

We were going to release the coming soon page yesterday, but Valve rejected the store page once due to a formatting issue, and here we are.

notes.title: SPOOKY CAT GIRLS 1 is now 100% STEAM DECK FRESH!

That’s right: [b]Furry Shakespeare: To Date Or Not To Date Spooky Cat Girls?[/b] is now officially Steam Deck Certified.

You can now romance spectral felines from the comfort of your haunted Steam Deck while ignoring the dying light of mankind’s final hour.

Thanks for playing our weird, romantic nonsense!
